method: Run 25 deterministic offline assertions against the full lesson, metadata and data ledger, plus the exact Python example with a fake SDK. Cross-check current Anthropic token-counting/Messages/compaction, OpenAI prompt-caching, and DeepSeek context-caching documentation. No provider call or historical run replay.

observations.trace: The fixture confirms named baseline deltas and validates unique labels and baseline existence before any fake provider call. The lesson narrows adjacent same-role message merging to documented Anthropic API contexts, separates count_tokens from cache usage/billing, and preserves the historical 238/298 and 234/238/234/254 figures only as non-reproducible summaries.

limitations: Historical request/response bodies, exact endpoint/model fingerprint, raw usage, task mapping and scorer are unavailable; historical token figures cannot be independently recomputed.
No live provider, cache, billing, answer-quality or production endpoint behavior was tested.
The fake SDK validates local wrapper/control flow only; it does not establish real token counts or provider runtime semantics.
Provider token-count and cache rules are model/API-specific and can change; consult current official documentation.
Visual verification uses a local static production build in a desktop browser; it does not validate responsive behavior on mobile or provider API behavior.
